gloss: to roast (coffee beans, tea leaves, etc.)

definitions.gloss: to roast (coffee beans, tea leaves, etc.)
definitions.explanation: To dry-roast raw beans, seeds, or leaves by applying heat, especially in the context of coffee or tea production.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー{豆|まめ}→コーヒー豆：25759_koohiimame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焙煎|ばいせん}する。
⟦{自家|じか}→自家：14071_jika⟧⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Home-roasted coffee has a different aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{度合|どあ}い→度合い：12456_doai⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The flavor of coffee changes greatly depending on the degree of roasting.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧ (roasting) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. A specialized term most commonly associated with coffee culture. With the rise of specialty coffee shops in Japan, this word has become widely known. The noun ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧ is used more often than the verb form, especially in compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自家|じか}→自家：14071_jika⟧⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧: home/in-house roasting
- ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}{度|ど}→焙煎度：26538_baisendo⟧: roast level; degree of roasting
- {浅煎|あさい}り: light roast
- {深煎|ふかい}り: dark roast
- ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}{機|き}→焙煎機：26214_baisenki⟧: roasting machine; roaster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{炒|い}る→炒る：13402_iru⟧: to roast; to parch — a native Japanese word used more broadly for roasting nuts, sesame, etc.
- ロースト⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to roast (loanword) — used in Western cooking contexts, especially for meat
